BiblicalUsage: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house, and flourishing in my palace. The word is the greenness itself, the prospering — and the dream that follows takes it all away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nebuchadnezzar flourishing in his palace is the calm before the fall, and Daniel tells the story straight.
